summary: The code meets FR-4 (a) to (d) for the 390 x 844 portrait case, and the r2 captures agree. The tests do not prove AC-4.1 (logo clear of the plaque) and AC-4.6 (the 0.76 to 0.84 per-line ratio). Rows 15 and 17 of the gate cannot pass, because the read functions omit the fields that the verdicts read. Row 18 cannot pass for the 403 page and the 404 view as written, and the teacher cases show 0 brand pairs. The unit test for the title length pins a custom property (--title-chars) that no CSS rule reads. The landscape media block (max-height 500 px) puts the logo over the level and week label, and the inline font size defeats the media font size. No unit test reads media blocks, so none of this shows. The inline style is safe: it holds only a number and constants. No caller of Frame is broken: Frame has one consumer. The vitest run was denied by the shell permission, so the plan test counts are not re-verified.
blocking_findings: F1 [Blocker] review-a: A-F1 The read functions of rows 15 and 17 of apps/storytime/__tests__/look-phase2-browser-gate.sh do not return logo_title_overlap_px, logo_h_px, line_count, or per_line_ratio, so brandChromeVerdict (line 351) and brandBannerVerdict (line 371) fail every live case. Rationale: AC-4.1 (logo clear of the plaque) and AC-4.6 (ratio 0.76 to 0.84 on every line, F-2) then have no executed proof. The --self-test passes only because it feeds synthetic good objects that hold the fields. The verdict fails closed, so this is not a vacuous pass (A4), but it never can pass. Also brandLongTitleVerdict (line 377) is used only by the self-test and by no live row, so the 60-character per-line ratio is never measured. Evidence: look-phase2-browser-gate.sh:2042-2075 (readBrandChrome), 2236-2255 (readBrandBanner), 2299-2312; gate-r2.log:223 and :225. Plan 2b.1 says rows 15, 17, and 18 hold the new contract; that claim is false for the read side (A5). Proposal: FIX by Red (the gate script is Red's file this round): add the four fields to the readers, call brandLongTitleVerdict in a live row, and add a self-test that runs a reader result through the verdict.

F2 [Blocker] review-a: A-F2 Row 18 cannot pass as written. The 403 page renders apps/storytime/app/[locale]/teacher/forbidden.tsx, which this phase did not change and which holds only a plain underlined link, so chrome_brand_pairs is 0 by design. The 404 view case fails on console_errors=1 for a page that is meant to answer 404. The teacher week and teacher day cases answer 200 with 0 pairs, although week-view.tsx and the day page carry brown button classes; the likely cause is that the gate session is not a teacher session and the page renders the forbidden view. Rationale: the checkpoint needs FAIL=0 (P2b.3 item 5 and P2b.4), and decision 1 (requirement (c) on every screen) has no passing live proof for screen 6 and screen 7. Evidence: look-phase2-browser-gate.sh:2320-2380; gate-r2.log:123-126 and :131. Proposal: FIX by Red (diagnose the teacher session and the expected 404 console error; set the per-page expectation). If the 403 link must take the chrome, ESCALATE that product call to the orchestrator and Green changes the class string of forbidden.tsx only.
nonblocking_findings: F3 [Major] review-a: A-F3 Landscape regression in the media block (max-height: 500px) of apps/storytime/app/look.css (about lines 765 to 786). The level and week label sits at left 12 px and top 30 px, and the logo sits at left 16 px, top 8 px, 48 px high, with z-index 2 over the label (z-index 1), so the logo covers the start of the label text at 844 x 390. The inline fontSize from apps/storytime/app/[locale]/frame.tsx:73-86 also defeats the media font-size of 20 px, so the plaque takes 72 px (cover) or 44 px (band) in a 64 px hero and its box reaches about 10 px above the top edge. Rationale: the cause is geometry from the CSS and the inline style; I did not run a browser. The unit tests filter media blocks out (rule.media.length === 0 in look-brand-chrome.test.ts F-1, F-2, and S10), and the landscape gate rows read only clipped_text and page_overflow, so a real hit is swallowed (A7). Proposal: FIX by Green (move the label or the logo in the media block, and let the media block cap the font), with a Red case that reads the media rules; capture 844 x 390 to confirm.

F4 [Major] review-a: A-F4 The F-2 frame test pins a dead hook. frame.tsx:76 sets --title-chars, but no CSS rule reads var(--title-chars) (grep of apps/storytime/app finds only the frame and a comment at look.css:178). lengthSignals in look-brand-chrome.test.tsx:270-283 accepts any numeric custom property or data attribute equal to the title length, so the test passes if the inline fontSize clamp goes away. The CSS F-2 case (look-brand-chrome.test.ts, 'F-2 the plaque rule sets a line rule') passes on the mere presence of white-space. Rationale: no unit test pins the real font rule (the clamp divisor 0.68, the 24 px floor, line-height 1.25, zero vertical padding), so a change to any of them fails nothing except the browser row of F1. Proposal: FIX by Red (assert the inline font-size value from the title length, line-height 1.25, and zero vertical padding); FIX by Green (remove --title-chars or use it; correct the look.css comment at line 178).

F5 [Nit] review-a: A-F5 Row 17 reads one title per locale (the level 2 week 1 title 'Hello!'), but decision F-2 requires the ratio for every title. The longest shipped titles are 13 characters ('Is It a Ball?' and 'Unit 1 Review'), and the width estimate is 0.68 em per character with no live proof. Rationale: the r2 captures cover w01 and w02 only. Evidence: look-phase2-browser-gate.sh:2257-2295; content/l2/w07.json and w08.json. Proposal: FIX by Red (loop over the shipped titles in the row).

F6 [Nit] review-a: A-F6 Spec.md AC-4.6 still says 'The banner height is a value of the rule and not a value of the text' and 'may step down one size step'. The orchestrator decision F-2 replaced both. Rationale: the spec and the code now disagree, and the next reviewer reads a contradiction. Evidence: spec.md:203. Proposal: ESCALATE to the spec owner (user or build session) to amend AC-4.6 and Q42 text.

F7 [Nit] review-a: A-F7 Known item K2 (song rows show active_line_index=0) has no Phase 2b cause in the diff: song.tsx changes one class string. The change in the gate numbers (contrast_pairs_checked 33 to 34 and contrast_skipped 1 to 0) fits the play button, which had a gradient background (skipped) and now has a solid amber fill (measured). No run of the song rows at the phase base proves the failure is old. Rationale: the 10 song rows still count in FAIL=16. Evidence: gate-r2.log:20-40 and :47-51; earlier logs in measure/runs/storytime_look_20261107/ux-p2-*/. Proposal: ESCALATE to the orchestrator (run the song rows once at 3480f904c, or accept the rows as known).

F8 [Nit] review-a: A-F8 frame.tsx:67 renders the logo with width={46} height={46}, and the CSS sets 48 px; the CSS wins, so the page is correct, but the attributes and the doc text disagree. The inline clamp uses 100cqi, so a browser without container query units drops the whole declaration and falls back to 72 px or 44 px. Rationale: low risk for current phones. Proposal: FIX by Green (set 48 in the attributes); the fallback is acceptable if the target browsers are recent.
evidence: HEAD equals audited_head_sha 4eebabbb2e062a21a95644279a97842f68ad0999 (git rev-parse HEAD). Range 3480f904c..4eebabbb2 holds 12 commits and 30 files.

FR-4 (a): frame.tsx renders no game bar, no crest, one visible [data-level-week] without aria-hidden, and one img [data-logo] with alt 'Storytime Advantage'. The logo file has viewBox 0 0 700 700, fill #fcd34d, a title, and no script, handler, foreignObject, or external href (grep).

FR-4 (c): look.css defines --st-amber and --st-brown at :root. The four chrome families use the two tokens. Remaining --sq-blue variables are defined but I found no chrome rule that uses them; the remaining blue-like values sit in tokens only. Screens 6 to 9 change only className strings (git diff of join, sign-in, not-found-view, st/page.tsx, teacher week-view and day page).
AC-4.7: git diff --stat 3480f904c..4eebabbb2 over packages/read-along, lib/highlight-windows.ts, and app/look/places prints nothing.

Callers: Frame has one consumer, app/[locale]/st/[level]/[week]/page.tsx:17. The removed hooks [data-game-bar], [data-crest], and the piece files q-bar.svg, q-crest.svg, q-tip-l.svg, q-tip-r.svg are updated in look-frame, look-council-r1, look-council-r2, look-council-r3, and look-assets; each old assertion became an equal or stronger assertion on the new hook (F1 to F3 now count labels and the logo).

Inline style: frame.tsx:73-86 sets --title-chars (a number) and fontSize from title.length and two constants. The title text is not interpolated into the style. A title of length 0 gives a divide by zero that clamp resolves to the maximum. The style is safe.
A3: the new count assertions use labeled integers (label_text_reads=, logo_pictures=, cases_checked=). No bare-digit count found in the new files.
A4: the verdicts of rows 15 and 17 read undefined fields and so fail closed. They cannot pass on a missing deliverable, but they cannot pass at all (F1).

A5: plan 2b.1 says 'the gate rows 15, 17, and 18 hold the new contract' and 2b.2 says '--self-test selftest_mutants_rejected=61 of 61'. The self-test proves the verdict functions only. The plan text for 2b.4 reports the 16 FAIL rows truthfully.

K1: confirmed (look-phase2-browser-gate.sh reader and verdict mismatch). K2: no Phase 2b cause found, see F7. K3: login-media-sign.test.ts is outside the phase diff (content import 345e02ba2, ancestor of the base); not a Phase 2b finding. K4: the fixture week 3/6 is meant to hold a long title, so the injected text probably has the same length and the missing --title-chars has little effect; --title-chars has no CSS reader at all (F4). K5: the Red log records the mid-red exit 1 with 4 failing cases, which is the expected state for Red; no finding.
The r2 captures r2-01, r2-02, r2-03 were named in the brief. I did not re-read the images; the orchestrator look check stands for portrait 390 x 844 only.

Vitest was not re-run: two attempts of the heavy-run command were denied by the shell permission ('Permission denied: shell'). The plan counts (Tests 100 passed, Tests 164 passed) are therefore not re-verified by this role.
